import importlib.util, json, time, random
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
rng = random.Random(1)
toks = ['svc_%03d' % i for i in range(24)]
atoms = []
seen = set()
while len(atoms) < 10:
    p = tuple(rng.choice(toks) for _ in range(16))
    op = rng.choice(['match', 'startswith', 'endswith', 'contains'])
    if (op, p) not in seen:
        seen.add((op, p)); atoms.append((op, p))
t0 = time.time()
tables = [m.make_monitor(op, list(p), toks)[0] for (op, p) in atoms]
print('monitor build for 10 atoms: %.3fs' % (time.time() - t0))
# full pipeline timing on a legal request with all 10 atoms
req = {'services': toks,
       'rules': [{'action': 'allow', 'when': {'op': 'or', 'args': [{'op': op, 'path': list(p)} for (op, p) in atoms]}}],
       'queries': [[toks[i % 24] for i in range(4096)] for _ in range(4)]}
t0 = time.time()
out = m.process(json.dumps(req).encode())
print('full line: %.3fs' % (time.time() - t0), 'out bytes', len(out))
print(json.loads(out).get('ok'), len(json.loads(out)['dfa']['next']))
